recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, double-exposure portrait featuring two scales of the same subject: a large, warm-toned close-up face in the background and a smaller, cool-toned full-head portrait in the foreground. The composition is anchored by heavy, blocky sans-serif typography at the top, utilizing a split-color scheme.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large background face and small foreground figure
Color temperature contrast between warm sepia-tones and cool cyan-tints
Typographic dominance over the upper third of the frame
Low-key lighting with deep shadows merging into a black background
coreInvariants: Tight cropping on the subject's features
Two-tone color split in the main title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large face occupies the left and center background; smaller figure positioned in the lower right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold blue and white text block at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright blue text, moves down to the large eye on the left, then follows the gaze to the smaller figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows surround the subjects, creating a moody, enclosed atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown shadows provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan-blue is used for primary text and highlights on the smaller figure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and off-white text provide a secondary contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between highlights and shadows; saturation is localized to the blue text and tinted highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are compressed vertically to fit a dense rectangular block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with different weights and colors to distinguish primary and secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the extreme verticality and tight counters seen in the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a double exposure portrait of a man. One large face in warm sepia tones fills the left side, looking down. A smaller, full-head portrait of the same man in cool cyan-blue tones is positioned in the lower right, looking forward. The background is solid black with dramatic, low-key lighting and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of text at the top. On the left, a large two-line title in ultra-bold cyan-blue condensed sans-serif. On the right, a three-line subtitle in bold off-white condensed sans-serif. Ensure the text is tightly packed and aligned to the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-bold and condensed?
Is there a clear color temperature difference between the two exposures?
Is the background deep black with minimal detail?
Is the typography the most prominent element in the upper third?

adjustableVariables: Proportion of the large face vs. small face
Specific shade of blue for the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the typography.
Ensure the double exposure looks integrated, not just pasted.
Verify the cyan tint is limited to the smaller figure and specific text.
Confirm the overall mood is soulful and dramatic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Double exposure portrait + high-contrast low-key lighting + ultra-bold condensed sans-serif typography + split-color temperature (warm/cool).
